liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Victim Or The Crime** (4 reviews): This is the first time the song was ever played, despite poor audio quality; The audience tape fails to capture the lowest bass notes and drumming witnessed live [5][7][12][14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The opening chords are glorious, but Jerry takes command after a slightly off-putting start [4]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-17.aud.holtz.nak100s.112317.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: This audience recording is considered the better-sounding option available for this date [10]
- **gd88-06-17.aud.goetz.19544.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 1.6/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: The reviewer claims this was the worst venue sound they had ever heard; The audio is a poor, slowed-down experiment making Jerry's voice unrecognizable and out of tune [8][13]
- **gd88-06-17.set2.sennheiser.ladner.19286.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 12 songs; 91 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as remote and cloudy, though it suffices for listening [4]

## Around the show

- The crowd went quiet when the song started, possibly due to shrooms [8]
- Bob announced the band would think about it and be back in a bit [12]
- For a tour opener, the performance is considered pretty darn good [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-17.aud.holtz.nak100s.112317.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; source: Recorded, transferred, tracked and FLACd by Greg Holtz; Field Equipment: Nakamichi CM100 CP-4 shotgun caps > D-5; [1]. Also: The setlist includes a jam following Eyes Of The World and Drums [1]
- **gd88-06-17.aud.goetz.19544.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(likely sennheiser)>?>CDR>WAV>SHN.SHN encoding via C.Ladner. [2]
- **gd88-06-17.set2.sennheiser.ladner.19286.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(likely sennheiser)>?>CDR>WAV>SHN.SHN encoding via C.Ladner. [3]
